subject: Medarus POC — acceptance KPIs, blockers, and go/no-go triggers
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medarus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Medarus POC — acceptance KPIs, blockers, and go/no-go triggers

Hi Liam — great conversation today. Per our demo and follow-up, I put together a focused MAP for the POC that highlights the acceptance KPIs, deterministic exit gates, and the concrete acceptance tests we'll run. Please find the attached Redwood-MAP-v2.pdf (high level) and SLA-Smoke-Test-Cases.xlsx (test cases).

Proposed high-level success criteria (short list):
- Functional: End-to-end inference correctness for the 6 canonical prompts (pass rate >= 90% against gold set).
- Performance: 95th percentile generation latency <= 350ms for 4k context under expected concurrency (as stated in MAP).
- Reliability: No more than 1 incident causing degraded responses during a 2-week pilot (rollup).
- Security: Submission of completed security questionnaire and confirmation on log retention policy (see Q3 below).

Exit gates (hard stop if unmet):
1) If the model fails the embedding/semantic match acceptance on the gold set after two remediation cycles.
2) If we cannot meet the latency SLO in your primary region (us-west) with the reserved capacity plan.
3) If SOC/IT raises an unresolved data residency or encryption issue that requires architecture changes.

Acceptance tests (examples):
- Gold-set accuracy run (owner: Medarus + Redwood) — pass threshold >= 90%.
- Load/latency sweep (owner: Redwood) — measure p95 at target concurrency.
- End-to-end smoke with synthetic PII redaction checks (owner: Medarus).

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (kickoff): confirm MAP and sign SOW (target: by 2/28).
- Week 1–2: deploy PoC stack + baseline runs.
- Week 3: acceptance test window and security validation.
- Week 4: signoff or list of remediation items + go/no-go decision.

Owners: Redwood (Tessa, Marissa) for runtime, deployment and test execution; Medarus (Liam, Sana) for gold-set, procurement, and security sign-off.

Action items for you: please confirm any missing acceptance tests, call out procurement windows, and forward the internal IT security contact so we can align on logging/retention.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medarus.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Rao <sana.rao@medarus.com>, IT Security Team <it-security@medarus.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Medarus POC — acceptance KPIs, blockers, and go/no-go triggers

Thanks Tessa — this looks like a solid start. A few thoughts up front:

1) Procurement window — our budget committee meets 3/5, but legal needs the SOW early. Can you confirm whether the SOW will reference a dedicated-capacity option (we prefer dedicated for compliance) and a cost cadence?
2) Security/Logging — forwarding to IT Security (cc'd). Their immediate ask is: what is the default log retention of request/response traces in the PoC? We need the ability to retain them for 90 days for audit.
3) Acceptance test refinement — we need a canary rollout test and a rollback trigger defined (e.g., if semantic accuracy for production traffic drops > 6% after a variant rollout).

Attaching a short doc with our POC constraints for context: Medarus-POC-constraints.docx (attached). Also looping in Sana from procurement to coordinate SOW timings.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood will cover a 3rd-party penetration scan during the pilot window or if we should budget for that separately?

On the acceptance tests, please explicitly call out who signs off the gold-set results (we need an executive signatory).

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Chief Technology Officer | Medarus Health
liam.oconnor@medarus.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medarus POC — acceptance KPIs, blockers, and go/no-go triggers

Tessa / Jordan — took a pass on Liam's asks and the MAP. Proposed updates below that we should send back as v2 (I'll attach a redline before finalizing):

- Add a dedicated-capacity option section and include an expected monthly committed capacity estimate (so procurement has numbers). Owner: Jordan (pricing lead).
- Update log retention to 90 days for PoC traces; for the pilot we'll provide configurable retention but default to 30 days. Add an annotation about storage cost impact. Owner: Redwood infra (Marissa).
- Canary rollout: define a 5/20 rollout (5% traffic for 24 hours, 20% for 48 hours) with a rollback trigger of semantic accuracy degradation > 5% or p95 latency increase > 40%. Owner: Redwood SRE + Medarus ops.
- Add an explicit executive sign-off line item: Medarus CTO or delegated product owner must sign the gold-set acceptance.
- Confirm penetration test scope: Redwood can cover an initial smoke pentest; anything full-scope will be billed as an add-on. Add legal loop for contract language.

I recommend we propose a firm SOW turn-around by 2/28 so procurement has time; Jordan, can you draft committed capacity numbers and example pricing tiers by EOD 2/25?

I'll prepare the updated MAP and the SLA test workbook (SLA-Smoke-Test-Cases.xlsx) and circulate for internal review before sending externally.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Medarus POC — updated MAP, acceptance tests, and next steps (SOW target 2/28)

Hi Liam / Sana — attaching the updated MAP (Redwood-MAP-v2.pdf) and the SLA-Smoke-Test-Cases.xlsx workbook that implements the acceptance tests we discussed. Key updates since the draft:

- Dedicated capacity option and example committed tiers (Jordan) included.
- Canary rollout plan: 5% for 24h -> 20% for 48h with rollback criteria (semantic accuracy drop >5% or p95 latency +40%).
- Log retention: PoC default 30 days with option to extend to 90 days (storage delta noted).
- Security: Redwood will fund an initial smoke pentest; full-scope pentest can be added as a billable extra.
- Executive sign-off: Medarus CTO or delegated signatory required for gold-set acceptance.

Next steps / commitments:
1) Medarus: confirm the executive signatory and procurement window. Sana — do you have availability to review the SOW language this week?
2) Redwood: finalize SOW and send via DocuSign by EOD 2/28 (link included).
3) Both: schedule kickoff for week of 3/8 pending SOW signature.

DocuSign SOW: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/ABC123-POC-SOW
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/6789123/company/medarus

If that aligns, we'll proceed to finalize pricing and execute. If there are any blockers from IT Security on retention or encryption, please flag immediately so we can scope mitigations.

Thanks all — excited to get this running.

—
